verdict.rationale: Apple's Mac User Guide has a dedicated switcher entry point covering how to find your way around the Mac and transfer files from a PC, and Setup Assistant and Migration Assistant guide first-time setup, including from Windows. The evidence does not show guided tutorials for actually installing or reinstalling the OS, and the interface-learning content appears only as brief index mentions. Missing for 10: guided OS installation/reinstallation tutorials, detail on the depth of desktop-interface walkthroughs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the switcher guides.
